verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's Agent mode lets users delegate coding tasks (e.g., 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name') and Copilot autonomously analyzes the codebase and generates edits, plus users can assign issues/PRs directly to Copilot as an agentic teammate. This is corroborated by docs and hands-on community reports of Copilot's real-world coding assistance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of Agent mode's autonomous multi-file execution (most community evidence is about inline suggestions, not agent delegation) and quantified success/reliability data for delegated tasks.
